name: firestore-rules-tests
description: Testes unitários das Firestore Security Rules — Futeba dos Parças

scripts.test: export JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"; firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project futebadosparcas 'FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8085 FIREBASE_STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9199 npx vitest run --reporter=verbose --no-file-parallelism --maxWorkers=1'

scripts.test:ci: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project futebadosparcas 'FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8085 FIREBASE_STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9199 npx vitest run --reporter=verbose --no-file-parallelism --maxWorkers=1'
